GLUE and WATER mix works well for REVERSE FLOWER DIP ~ Acrylic pour painting ~ Paint #WithMe

I have some online class today with a lovely lady Shauna and we used PVA glue and water mix as our pouring medium. So I had some paints left and decided to do a reverse flower dip with them and I am thrilled with the result.

Technique: Reverse flower dip with paper napkin, Flower chapped desert cup bottom pour

Process:

- Pour your base on canvas

- Put your cup on the canvas with bottom up

- Pour paints on the bottom and use pearl white or some metallic paints between to create petal - lacing effect

- Take off the cup

- Use skewer to draw some flower shapes

- Gently put paper napkin on canvas ( You can use dry or damped napkin)

- Lift one corner at the time and then gently lift it (the middle last)

- Torch it for air bubbles and to activate pearl white

- And here is your flower :)

- Boesner titanium white

- Pearl white

- Maimieri light gold

- Arties colours alizarian crimson

- Amsterdam naples yellow red hue light

- Rayher metallic pink

- Amsterdam permanent blue violet

- Artina magenta

1 part Vallejo pearl medium

1 part titanium white

2 parts pouring medium
